nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: The repository warns that its Next.js version has breaking changes and requires consulting the local Next.js guidance before writing code.

nodes.label: Scrypt Password Hashing
nodes.rationale: Admin passwords are stored as scrypt hashes rather than plaintext, and replacement credentials are generated through a script.

nodes.label: Approved Membership Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Only bootcamp_participants grants approved access; pending and rejected requests must remain outside the membership table.

nodes.label: Transactional Approval State Change
nodes.rationale: Approved requests are promoted into membership in one PostgreSQL transaction, with constraints and guarded updates preventing inconsistent or duplicate transitions.

nodes.label: Approval Workflow Verification
nodes.rationale: The implementation is gated by backend tests, UI source tests, lint, production build, diff inspection, and database-sensitive security checks.

nodes.label: Transactional Admin Review
nodes.rationale: Approval inserts membership and records review metadata atomically; rejection records history without creating membership.

nodes.label: Approval Security Constraints
nodes.rationale: Only active bootcamps are requestable, only admins review, and database constraints prevent duplicate requests or memberships.

nodes.label: Approval Design Verification
nodes.rationale: The design requires lifecycle, authorization, bootstrap-scope, UI-copy, lint, and build verification.
